stem.text: An oil drop has mass $m$ and charge $q$. The drop is held stationary in an electric field between two parallel horizontal plates, a distance $d$ apart, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery labelled V connected across two horizontal parallel plates. A dot labelled oil drop lies between the plates. A vertical double-headed arrow labelled d marks the separation of the plates.

stem.text: The potential difference between the plates is $V$ and the acceleration of free fall is $g$.
What is the charge-to-mass ratio $\dfrac{q}{m}$ of the oil drop?
